Also serving: Temecula, Wildomar, Menifee, Lake Elsinore, Canyon Lake, Winchester, Sun City, Hemet (Riverside County, Southern California)

## Services Offered

- **Landscape Design** — Custom landscape plans tailored to Murrieta's hot, dry climate and HOA requirements. ([/services/landscape-design](https://landscapingmurrieta.com/services/landscape-design))
- **Lawn Care** — Regular maintenance programs to keep lawns green and healthy year-round in inland SoCal. ([/services/lawn-care](https://landscapingmurrieta.com/services/lawn-care))
- **Irrigation Systems** — Water-efficient drip and smart irrigation solutions that comply with EVMWD/RCWD water restrictions. ([/services/irrigation](https://landscapingmurrieta.com/services/irrigation))
- **Seasonal Cleanup** — Spring and fall yard cleanup, leaf removal, and debris hauling. ([/services/seasonal-cleanup](https://landscapingmurrieta.com/services/seasonal-cleanup))

- Specializes in drought-tolerant and California-native plant landscaping

- Water-saving irrigation focus due to EVMWD/RCWD conservation mandates
- Free on-site consultations
- Murrieta climate: USDA zone 9b–10a, hot dry summers, mild winters
